name: a plain off-white outside with a standing person, an x-ray lens on the belly, and the inside of the organs: a pink stomach cavern (squeezing walls, folds, a pool of fluid, rising gas bubbles, a ring-shaped exit) and a ringed tunnel of small intestine
fits: anything that happens inside the body and can be heard or felt from outside: stomach rumbles, hiccups, a heartbeat, a swallowed gulp; the hero is the person at the hook and the organs once the camera dives in
recipe: flat 2D, no iso: a Chibi person on plain off-white (the hook); a round lens on the belly holding the whole stomach and small intestine; the camera zooms into the lens and on into the stomach: a pink wall with soft fold bands, two big lobes that press in from the sides, a pool of fluid with a lit surface, gas bubbles that rise, a food lump, a round muscle ring round a dark exit; a push through the exit into a tunnel of concentric pink rings that flow toward the viewer and narrow where a squeeze wave passes, with bubbles flowing; the camera zooms back out of the lens to the person
